title: Service-port Hyper-V rules from SSOT (PR #31)
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the elevated platform gate runs on a host with the Hyper-V rule cmdlets THE SYSTEM SHALL hold exactly one inbound TCP allow rule per [firewall].open_ports port, scoped to the resolved [ssh.windows].remote_addresses, with DefaultInboundAction left Block

verification.negative_expect: clean suite passes; unscoped, default-allow and non-ssot-port each fail their named test

verification_evidence: e01163d: pwsh tests/test_getmios_wsl_service_ports.ps1 -PlantDefect -> 20/20 pass, plants unscoped/default-allow/non-ssot-port each fail named test; host_security 28/28 plants, field 5/5; CI validate-windows+linux green

title: One rendered SSOT networking_mode across every .wslconfig writer
acceptance_criteria: WHEN any installer path writes .wslconfig THE SYSTEM SHALL write networkingMode equal to the resolved SSOT [wsl2].networking_mode and no writer shall substitute its own mode

verification.negative_expect: every writer renders the SSOT value; a planted hardcoded mode fails its named test

title: hostAddressLoopback rendered from SSOT in mirrored mode
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the resolved networking_mode is mirrored THE SYSTEM SHALL write [experimental] hostAddressLoopback from SSOT, and WHEN it is not mirrored THE SYSTEM SHALL not write it

verification.negative_expect: mirrored renders the key from SSOT; NAT omits it; a planted always-on or hardcoded value fails

title: PR #31 to MiOS spec (audit findings)
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the spec audit lists a blocking or should_fix finding against PR #31 THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve it in both repos or record why it is out of scope

verification.negative_expect: audit findings closed; suite and plants hold

title: Mirror Get-MiOS.ps1 and SSOT changes into mios.git
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the bootstrap change is landed THE SYSTEM SHALL carry the same Get-MiOS.ps1 bytes and SSOT keys in mios.git through its own PR, passing mios.git's mirror gate

verification.positive_cmd: the mios.git bootstrap-sync check reports Get-MiOS.ps1 identical
verification.negative_control_cmd: a planted one-byte drift in the mios.git copy fails the sync check
verification.negative_expect: mirror gate green; planted drift red

title: Scope the Windows Defender LAN rules and portproxy to SSOT ports and remote addresses
acceptance_criteria: WHEN build-mios.ps1 opens Windows Defender inbound rules or portproxy entries for MiOS-DEV THE SYSTEM SHALL open only [firewall].open_ports ports, each rule scoped to [ssh.windows].remote_addresses, with no hardcoded port defaults

verification.negative_expect: rules equal SSOT ports with SSOT scope; planted unscoped rule or literal port fails its named test

title: Profile-restricted, tighten-only, normalised service-port scope
acceptance_criteria: WHEN service-port Hyper-V rules are reconciled THE SYSTEM SHALL restrict them to [firewall.windows].profiles, accept operator scope entries only inside the vendor scope, include the tailnet IPv6 prefix, and compare read-back addresses after normalising mask form so a second run makes no change

verification.negative_expect: planted profile-any, operator-widening and mask-form drift each fail a named test
